frontendDeployment.scope: Frontend deployment and anonymous login rendering only; no backend requests, account changes, provider delivery or authenticated workflows exercised.

implementation: Arabic student terminology replaced in both clients, API responses, report/export labels and new reminders; internal contracts and historical data unchanged.
Application status moved from sidebar into a labelled 44px header icon.
Admin sidebar consolidated into a 240px sticky column with compact links and internal scrolling; obsolete overlays/spacing overrides removed.
Shared dialog and import-result close controls use the same themed Material close icon and 44px targets.
Icon dimensions fixed before font load; legacy table negative margins removed and page padding standardized.
Native select appearance unified with the shared dark theme and RTL-aware arrows without replacing native keyboard selection.

builds.backend: Succeeded with no errors; existing pinned ImageSharp warnings unchanged.

chromium.result: All Chromium cases completed without reported failures in the combined run; the later Firefox phase was interrupted.

functionalVerification.coverage: Both applications: reachable routes, login/onboarding, dialogs, contrast/accessibility, print and selection. Dedicated navigation checks cover status-icon placement, last-link reachability, close/ Escape/focus restoration and contained scrolling.

firefox.reason: The bundled browser stalls/fails during page/session setup or teardown on this Windows host (SWGL/Juggler/session-store errors), including an isolated one-worker retry. Some routes/dialogs were exercised successfully, but a complete fresh run cannot be certified. Experimental rendering overrides were removed.
testCorrections: Allow subpixel rounding in DOM rectangle assertions (44 vs 43.999996).
Give the many-route/dialog accessibility matrices a 300-second whole-case budget and scope dialog audits to the open dialog.
firefox.remaining: Complete Firefox functional and visual verification on a working host before closing this UI revision.

churchUiRevision.deployment: Local changes only; no workflow, backend startup-migration setting or dependency version changed.

visualVerification.note: Final baselines refreshed and inspected after header/sidebar, terminology, close-control and native-select theme changes. All 40 Chromium/WebKit cases pass; Firefox baseline refresh/verification remains incomplete.

checks: Native keyboard selection changes the value

churchUiRevision.supersededBy: churchServiceReportsRevision: the previously incomplete fresh Firefox gate passed on 2026-10-12.

churchServiceReportsRevision.scope: Admin navigation and church-service reporting; local changes only
implementation: 13 ordered navigation links; statistics remains the default route; small header status icon
Flush 240px desktop sidebar; accessible flush mobile drawer up to 320px; independently scrollable links
One catalog with four groups and twenty cards; old routes retained or redirected
Historical confirmed attendance ownership; current pastoral ownership; actor-based deduplicated visit credits; distinct youths; explicit reasons and unknown coverage
SQL filtering, aggregates and pagination; stable IDs; full filtered Excel/CSV/print; Cairo month dates and configurable absence/contact thresholds
Drilldowns for servant, current group, group attendance, own attendance, activity and open tasks; explicit task creation only
Overlapping identical reads share work without retaining completed report results; cancellation and fresh subsequent reads verified
Current roster excludes archived youths while historical activity remains available

backend.coverage: SQL Server: identical names, role changes, deactivated actors, archive/reassignment, shared and legacy visits, unknown/cancelled meetings, date boundaries, defaults, scope/403, paging/totals, native XLSX dates/phone text, CSV/full reads and concurrent cancellation

latestFilterPersistence.coverage: 14 final new-report cases per Chromium/WebKit engine, including the added group-attendance link; all passed.

firefoxTargeted.coverage: Navigation and new reports across all eight widths, landscape, zoom, keyboard/focus, drilldowns, applied exports, error/empty states and saved URL filters

firefoxBroad.coverage: Final build: both apps, all reachable routes/dialogs, navigation, all eight widths and landscape/200% reflow, accessibility, print, old/new report links, applied-filter exports, saved URL state and visual states.

browser.visualBaselines: 18 final new-report baselines (three reports, 390/1440px, all three engines), plus refreshed applicable existing populated/empty/loading/failed/validation/saving baselines. Desktop and portrait outputs inspected.

finalCaptures.note: The extra forced-baseline capture run had one Firefox 390px route-switch timeout while another Firefox run overlapped; five cases passed. Its isolated retry passed in 5.4 seconds. The independent broad Firefox run already passed all 73 cases without retries.

churchServiceReportsRevision.constraints: ImageSharp 3.1.5, .NET 8, startup migrations, migrations/model, credentials and frontend-only Pages workflow unchanged.

performance.scope: 20 concurrent authenticated managers, 60 samples per operation; identical and twenty distinct area/page and owner queries; SQL Express on the documented local host. ASP.NET TestServer transport excludes external network/TLS/IIS latency. No completed-report cache or schema/index changes.

churchServiceReportsRevision.deployment: Not published. Both frontend and API changes require deployment; the Pages workflow remains frontend-only.

activitySpacingRevision.deployment: Local changes only; API and both clients require publication.
changes: PersonalActivityPage explicitly supplies the authenticated actor; unfiltered activity API reads also default to that actor for every role, including Admin/Manager/Priest
Calls use the recorded actor; visits include recorder or participant without duplicate rows; explicit authorized student/actor histories preserve existing permissions and historical/archived records

Added applied date range, youth-name/notes search, outcome and active/voided filters; page changes retain filters, activity-kind changes reset the incompatible outcome, superseded reads are cancelled, invalid dates never submit

A single shared --page-gutter matches the former servant-list gutter (clamp 12px, 2vw, 24px); authenticated layout owns it once; nested page/container padding and narrow outer wrappers removed; title margin collapse corrected
Request-add form uses shrinkable grid tracks and wrapping actions to support 320px at 200% text size

backend.coverage: Five actual API role cases plus three import/archive regressions: default and explicit actor scope, recordId narrowing, authorized student histories, archived youth/changed owner, shared visits, totals vs page rows, inclusive Cairo calendar dates, search/outcome/state validation and 403/400 behavior.

initialFinalRun.coverage: 36 new activity/spacing cases, six print cases and sixty existing visual-state cases; both apps, eight widths, two landscape sizes, 200% reflow, accessible filter controls and applied-filter paging/switch/reset.

finalRoutes.coverage: Twelve all-reachable-route cases across both apps at 320/1920px and six church-report capture cases at 390/1440px, on Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. No page-wide overflow or obscured headings. Eighteen maintained report baselines refreshed.
finalRoutes.personalHistoryRecheck: Five of six personal-activity repeats passed in the combined run; Firefox Admin had a locator timeout. Both Firefox personal-activity cases passed in isolation without source changes (2 passed, no retries). Final portrait capture inspected.

activitySpacingRevision.constraints: ImageSharp 3.1.5, .NET 8, automatic startup migrations, appsettings credentials and frontend-only Pages workflows unchanged.

unifiedPagesRevision.deployment: Local changes only; publish the API and both clients together.
changes: One canonical /requests page per app; Admin sidebar has one requests entry. Type (including all), status and personal scope are URL-backed filters; paging retains applied filters and refresh/back preserve them. Ordinary roles always send personal scope.

Mixed request feed counts, orders and pages the three request tables in SQL, then reads at most one bounded detail projection per kind. Each row includes its kind; review/approve/reject/withdraw use the row kind, including stale-review refresh. Single-kind API contracts remain available.

Legacy addition/assignment/removal/history links redirect with matching filters and keep request-ID links; privileged request-ID history links retain global review access. Approval report drilldowns target the canonical page.

One distribution report selects area/year/birth month; old group routes redirect. Explicit missing-group labels and drilldowns include birthMonth=0. The current-student list now retains that missing-birthday filter.

One servant activity report selects custom period or the existing server-defined report week; old weekly route redirects. Existing row details and paging/sorting remain available. Three duplicate catalog entries and eight unreachable report source/template files removed.

Both API-scoped interceptors encode audit-reason headers explicitly; CallerContext decodes the marked URI value. Arabic body reasons and audited original text are preserved; legacy unmarked headers keep their existing behavior.

backend.coverage: Five roles: all-kind SQL union translation/count/stable paging, own/global scope and 403, detail parity including archived targets and prior single-kind contracts, withdrawal and Arabic audit reason round trip, invalid filters. Two existing approval retry/stale transaction cases plus the existing archived history API regression.

browser.coverage: 51 unified-page cases (seven workflows and ten viewport/reflow cases per engine), 18 session/interceptor regressions, six all-route 320px cases, six church-report/catalog capture cases and 24 Admin report visual-state cases.

broadRun.cause: The three grouping drilldown cases exposed the existing StudentQueriesService dropping the explicit missing-birthday value 0. The list and service now preserve 0.

finalAffectedRun.coverage: After the final production build, all three grouping/drilldown cases and nine 320/390/1440px responsive/accessibility cases pass across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Includes missing birthdays and a known May birthday group.

browser.visualReview: Final requests and distribution portrait captures inspected; affected maintained Admin/report baselines refreshed.

unifiedPagesRevision.constraints: ImageSharp 3.1.5, .NET 8, automatic startup migrations, appsettings credentials and frontend-only Pages workflows unchanged.
